metadata.title: Enfortumab Vedotin and Pembrolizumab Therapy
metadata.indication: First-line treatment of unresectable or metastatic urothelial carcinoma.
metadata.partial_assessment_note: Any independently actionable entered value is assessed; omitted domains remain unassessed and do not block a partial result.
metadata.partial_assessment_policy: Each entered value is assessed independently. Omitted domains remain unassessed and are never assumed normal.

catalogue_reconciliation.scope_note: The NCCP states that its website list is not comprehensive. This reconciliation does not assert that every possible national regimen is published online.

clinical_governance.prescriptive_authority: Treatment plan must be initiated by a Consultant Medical Oncologist or the specialist authority specified in the current NCCP source.
clinical_governance.dose_modification_note: Use the most restrictive applicable component rule and confirm all dose changes against the current official NCCP PDF.
clinical_governance.disclaimer: Decision-support encoding derived from NCCP 00945 Version 1. It does not replace the current official regimen, prescribing review, pharmacy verification or independent clinical judgement.

indications.description: First-line treatment of unresectable or metastatic urothelial carcinoma.

treatment.schedule_summary: Enfortumab vedotin days 1 and 8 plus pembrolizumab day 1 every 21 days; an NCCP 42-day pembrolizumab option also exists.

action.message: Creatinine ≥1.5 × baseline/ULN requires assessment for immune nephritis and competing causes.

action.message: New endocrine/neurological symptoms require urgent symptom-directed endocrine assessment; optional endocrine bloods must not block partial assessment.

action.message: Marked hyperglycaemia requires withholding enfortumab vedotin and metabolic assessment.
